title: Sperm Whales blow bubbles to achieve restful, vertical sleep
summary: Researchers from the University of St Andrews discovered that sperm whales create bubble curtains around themselves while sleeping vertically in the ocean, possibly to help them rest without constant jaw clenching or to mask their scent from predators.
problem_solved: Understanding the unique sleeping behavior and bubble-producing mechanism of sperm whales in their natural habitat
why_valuable: Provides rare scientific insights into marine mammal sleep behavior, which is difficult to study due to the challenges of observing deep-ocean creatures
